أُطْرَةٌ The sinew that is wound immediately above the notch of an arrow; (S, K;) as also ↓ إِطَارٌ . (K.) ―
-b2- The edge of the glans of the penis; (K, * TA;) as also ↓ the latter word. (K, TA.) ―
-b3- The flesh surrounding the nail: (K:) pl.أُطَرٌ and إِطَارٌ. (TA.) ―
-b4- A mixture of ashes and blood with which a fracture in a cooking-pot is smeared (S, K) and repaired. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
